criteria_results.text: Attachment pickers do not gate on file type; any selected file reaches the consumption path.
criteria_results.notes: Real-surface Flutter coverage and fork web picker coverage passed, including an arbitrary .rhythmfixture attachment.

criteria_results.text: An agent receiving a file with no built-in reader searches or surfaces a compatible skill, MCP tool/server, or trusted external reader instead of silently failing.
criteria_results.notes: The built standalone engine persisted the exact reader-discovery task after a real API WebSocket file turn; path, MIME, extension, skills, MCP, and web fallback were all observed.

process_issues.description: The launcher reported healthy, but its detached API process was reaped when the tool shell exited, so the first live test failed at beforeAll with ECONNREFUSED.
process_issues.detected_by: Immediate connection refusal plus a clean sandbox log with no exception or shutdown event; the same build remained healthy in a foreground tool-owned session.

process_issues.description: The default-concurrency Flutter suite reached 812 passing tests before compiler output failed with ENOSPC.
process_issues.detected_by: Flutter's output.dill write failed with errno 28; after deleting only reproducible caches from completed worktrees, the serial full suite passed 979/979.

process_issues.description: Shared fork package symlinks initially resolved the primary checkout's core package and reproduced the compiled containsReal failure from #1133.
process_issues.detected_by: A prompt cancellation/tool path reported AppFileSystem.containsReal undefined; the #1132 built-runtime follow-up fixed the binding and the coordinator live build passed.

suggested_follow_up: Add a foreground mode to tools/dev/sandbox.sh and keep built/minified binary behavior in every fork feature's required live gate.
